50	 * (e.g. layout + page) are deduplicated — only one round-trip per request.

53	 */

55	  const supabase = await createClient()
56	  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
57	
58	  if (authError || !user) return null
59	
60	  const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase
61	    .from('profiles')
62	    .select('*')
63	    .eq('id', user.id)
64	    .single()
65	
66	  if (profileError || !profile) return null
67	
68	  return {
69	    user: { ...(profile as ProfileRow), authId: user.id },
